no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee meeting was not held for viltolarsen.

summary: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for the viltolarsen (VILTEPSO) NDA212154 application; the Medical Review states plainly under Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) that 'An Advisory Committee meeting was not held for viltolarsen.' The Summary Review lists an Advisory Committee section only in its table of contents, with no meeting described. Because no committee was convened, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
